testedSource.basis: Canonical LF for text; exact binary assets. Source identity is not semantic parity.

coveredChanges: Codex adds conditional exact-name discovery guidance for installed runtimes that expose deferred MCP tools; selected models and other adapters remain unchanged.
Native structured questions use compact source-derived pending/answer cards, display masking for declared passwords, stable widgets and scoped label links.

Direct Codex and Claude sessions expose the native shared-question MCP helper with owner-scoped complete/cancel routing, separate command approvals, paused human-wait deadlines and duplicate wrapper projection.
Only provably absent retained historical attachments degrade to bounded logical-label notices; explicit current attachments and invalid captured bytes remain errors.
ACP captured-file resources carry source-derived optional image MIME hints from validated names without changing original bytes or permissions.
Idle selected model labels retain their beginning and right ellipsis; focused search, saved identity and manual typing remain unchanged.

liveValidation.scope: Actual Windows ADE composer, real managed model invokes shared MCP question, user selection submitted through native form, exact final ADE_SHARED_QUESTION_OK. No auth UI or credential extraction.

limits: All701 feature rows and17331 indexed source function bodies remain preserved. Full semantic, line-by-line and identical model-reasoning parity is not established.
Actual installed CLI question access can use a deferred tool registry rather than direct tool advertisement. Local synthetic discovery and actual managed model inference are reported separately.
Declared password masking is a presentation rule for the native question card; canonical tool results and independently model-authored assistant text remain unchanged.
Question labels use the bounded native Markdown renderer and existing owner/row/part/mount validation. No automatic media loading is added.
Historical attachment absence handling is a deliberate native extension; pinned ACP replays historical text only. Invalid-vs-Missing handling is stricter than its catch-all current-file fallback.
MIME is an extension hint, not content authentication. ACP original20MiB inline image transport remains a separate private implementation.
Existing native model selector remains an editable combo; provider logo and separate search popup layout are not yet source-identical.
Custom model CRUD/options, advanced account/usage paths, historical browser environment snapshots and other source-ledger gaps remain.
